    nt = [d for d in diffs if d[0]!=0]

r1 = action(['DOWN']); print('down1 go:', r1.get('game_over'))
if not r1.get('game_over') and not r1.get('done'):
    r2 = action(['DOWN']); print('down2 go:', r2.get('game_over'), 'done:', r2.get('done'))
print('timer', [x['pixels'] for x in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if x['color']=='N'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
